All 11 elderly are rescued with no deferrals. Kispang temple is not an evacuation point, so it is not used. The car makes three round trips, which is the minimum for 11 people at 4 per trip. The Kalika trip costs 14 minutes. The two Trishuli trips cost 78 minutes each, for a total of 170.
